Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: The Planner confused the developer with the publisher, shifting the answer to Square Enix and even instructing verification that Square Enix developed Tomb Raider (2013). In fact, Crystal Dynamics is the developer (Square Enix is the publisher), so this conflation led toward the wrong company for the question.
